spec_refs: _GROUNDING.md §8 (export pipelines; P10b live export bytes from DeliverableEvent)

purpose: Proves the export fail-closed rule: a DeliverableEvent whose payload is 0 bytes (empty export artifact) must be rejected at the validate stage; an export must never deliver an empty file.
rationale: P10b established that real export bytes must flow through the DeliverableEvent. A 0-byte payload means the bundle stage produced nothing real; fail-closed export requires validate to reject it rather than deliver an empty file, so the oracle returns fail.
